Be curious about vibe-coding and using AI with natural language. Embrace context engineering. Build something combing tools that's Lovable. ✨

Michael SpencerJul 26, 2025∙ Paid1419ShareLoveable Share

Hello Everyone, 

Lovable is one of the most viral vibe-coding tools and the fastest growing one out of Europe. It’s gone basically from $0 to $75M ARR (annual recurring revenue) in 7 months. It’s a unicorn. 🦄 It’s also leading the way in altering how we build online. 

The real No-Code revolution begins in 2025

Try It

As AI coding gets better how we build things online in natural language is beginning to really change in 2025. It’s frankly one of the most noticeable applied AI trends of the year. 

We should note that the best vibe coding tools tend to use Anthropic’s Claude Code. Claude Code by the Open-AI spinout, Anthropic, is considered by many to be a top-tier AI coding assistant due to its strong reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities, especially within large or unfamiliar codebases.

Lovable also like Cursor, utilizes Claude's code generation capabilities as its primary engine for software development, particularly for tasks requiring reliability and quality. Cursor raised $900 million in June. 

In the AI coding space and vibe-coding spectrum, Lovable and Cursor have emerged as major winners. 

Generally speaking Cursor for technical users and SWEs and Loveable for non-technical and more solopreneurs, product and design focused users. 

The AI Hype boom is manufacturing reasons to keep itself Alive 🤯

The U.S. markets are in a bizarre and artificially created state of euphoria. 

No one says 'no-code' anymore.  Even the big platforms are now saying 'built with AI.'

The Enterprise use case? The best use case right now? Prototyping.
It’s hard to articulate an idea. Tools like this make it 100x easier.

How many revenue-generating products actually exist on Lovable?
Non technical people build, get excited - then don't know how to connect Stripe or Supabase. This is that story!  Does it matter if you are prototyping on Lovable, bubble.io or base44? 🤔 Depends on the vibe of the interface you like in part. 

Why is this a Big Deal?

This past week Loveable announced that it’s just crossed $100M ARR in 8 months. That’s not a normal trajectory. 

Lovable is now able to think, take actions, and adapt its plan as it works through your request.

✨ New Lovable agent: works more like a real developer by breaking down the problem, exploring the codebase, and making edits.

According to the Founder: “With 91% fewer errors and a more autonomous Lovable, it should feel like you're now working with a senior developer.”

Faster than OpenAI, Cursor, Wiz, and every other tech company in history. Loveable hit hit $100M ARR in 8 months 🔥. 

What is Lovable?

Lovable is an AI-driven app development platform designed to simplify the creation of full-stack web applications using natural language prompts. 

It allows users, regardless of coding expertise, to build functional apps and websites quickly by describing their ideas in plain English. Here’s a breakdown of what Lovable is used for:

Frontend 

App and Website Development: Lovable generates front-end and back-end code, including databases, to create fully functional web applications or marketing websites, such as e-commerce platforms, productivity tools, or CRMs. For example, users have built a VC investor database and CRM to help founders raise capital.

Prototyping 

Rapid Prototyping: It enables fast iteration and testing of ideas by generating app skeletons from simple instructions, reducing setup time for developers and non-technical users.

Collaborative Iteration 

Integration with Third-Party Services: Lovable supports seamless integration with tools like Supabase for databases, Stripe for payments, or OpenAI for text generation, making it versatile for various app functionalities.

Deployment: Apps can be deployed directly within the platform or via services like Netlify or Vercel, providing shareable URLs for live apps.

Customization and Collaboration: It offers editable source code with GitHub sync, real-time collaboration (in beta), and visual editing tools for refining UI and logic without wasting resources.

Security and Maintenance: Features like AI-powered security scans help identify vulnerabilities before publishing, ensuring safer apps.

People are Searching Google for Lovable more in the Summer of 2025

Google Trends (last year) terms Replit (Yellow), Vibe Coding (Red) and Lovable (Blue). 

“The future of software is not written. It’s talked into existence.”

A small startup out of Stockholm Sweden is trending. Loveable also has: 

A lot of use cases (you can build a lot of things with Lovable)

Intersects Product Managers, Designers and Context Engineers

Professionals who might use it are non-technical founders, product designers, and sales teams

Among the various no-code tools of the Generative AI era, Lovable is now among the fastest growing

Lovable is how solopreneur AI tool builders test out their ideas. The legendary Founders starting from scratch

Lovable is surprisingly popular mong product managers for example - BigTech product leaders prototyping faster than engineering ever could

How popular? About 70,000 new apps are being created on the platform every day

The platform is celebrated for empowering non-coders to build apps quickly, often 20x faster than traditional coding but ideal for less complex projects. 

It was reported recently that some BigTech interviews for PMs included vibe-coding assessments. 

In May, 2025 Substack’s own Elena Verna joined as Lovable’s Head of Growth. 

The New Loveable Agent - Some Use cases

Funding

Lovable became a Unicorn startup on July 17th, 2025 after a $200 million funding round. 

The Series A was quite dramatic, since that’s just eight months since its launch, the round led by Accel at a $1.8 billion valuation.

What we used to call “no-code” has suddenly morphed into a vibe-coding phenomena. Early investors in Lovable include 20VC, ByFounders, Creandum, Hummingbird, and Visionaries Club. 

The Series A round also attracted a long list of angel investors, including Klarna CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski, Remote CEO Job van der Voort, Slack co-founder Stewart Butterfield, and HubSpot co-founder Dharmesh Shah. 

Stockholm-based Lovable helps people use natural language to create websites and apps.

Lovable, is about a 40-person team, built a platform where you can create full web apps just by chatting with AI. Frontend, backend, database - all generated from a text prompt. No code required.

Although it’s mostly used to create prototypes and demos for actual products. 

As of July, 2025 the company says it has 2.3 million active users. 

How to Begin

Step 1

To get started, head over to lovable.dev and create an account.

Step 2

Once registered, you’ll be able to create your first project.

Step 3

Simply enter an initial prompt to kick things off, and Lovable will do the rest! This is the starting block for any project in Lovable, where you can bring your ideas to life instantly.

Upgrade to Access all Guides

🎨 The idea is to make you more curious about trying vibe-coding yourself. If design and building apps interests you, Lovable is a great place to start. If you want to be a solopreneur without learning how to code, educate yourself:
